title: Circuit team cap
desc: Baseball cap with a rounded visor and star badge; the Jelly Circuit team cap (crown = team colour).
convention: anchor_rest=(0,1.3458,0) = crown of the egg (BobForm.top). Mesh vertices are REST-space offsets from the anchor: restPos = anchor_rest + v. Axes = body rest axes (y up, +z face, x = Jelly's right-of-screen when facing camera). Carry: world = bodyPointWorld(restPos) per vertex (same maths as EyeMaskModel).
